metadata.chunk_title: Why study Speech and Language Therapy at UL?

programme_facts.value: University of Limerick (UL) is proud to introduce a Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Speech and Language Therapy. Building on our long-standing success with the graduate-entry MSc programme, this undergraduate degree is designed to equip you with the knowledge, skills, and confidence to become a competent, reflective, and evidence-based practitioner in the field of speech and language therapy.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study Speech and Language Therapy at UL?

programme_facts.value: Throughout your studies, you will benefit from a dynamic and supportive learning environment that emphasises interprofessional education. You will have the opportunity to collaborate and learn alongside students from other allied health disciplines—fostering teamwork, broadening your perspective, and preparing you for real-world clinical settings.
